features.name: Implements
features.summary: Choose two implement schools and physical objects through which you cast their spells and resonant powers.

features.name: Mental Focus
features.summary: Invest psychic energy in implements to activate resonant and focus powers.
features.uses: Occultist level + Intelligence modifier points per day

features.name: Focus Power
features.summary: Learn a focus power belonging to one of your implement schools.

features.name: Magic Item Skill
features.summary: Add half your Occultist level to Use Magic Device checks.

features.name: Object Reading
features.summary: Learn information from an object's psychic impressions.

features.name: Shift Focus
features.summary: Move mental focus between implements while retaining part of the invested energy.

features.name: Aura Sight
features.summary: Read magical auras as an enhanced detect magic effect.

features.name: Outside Contact
features.summary: Use an implement to contact an outsider for knowledge or service.

features.name: Binding Circles
features.summary: Create magic circles capable of binding called outsiders.

features.name: Fast Circles
features.summary: Create binding circles much more quickly.

features.name: Implement Mastery
features.summary: Master one implement school, expanding its focus and improving every power from it.
